name: Government Data Centre, Lilongwe
developer: Government of Malawi / Public Private Partnership Commission / Department of e-Government
notes: World Bank results brief says a new data center in Lilongwe was constructed for government hosting needs; PPPC/DIGMAP described it as the primary Government Data Centre, World Bank funded, 51% complete in March 2024 and expected by May 2024. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Expansion of the National Data Centre, Lilongwe
developer: Government of Malawi / Public Private Partnership Commission
notes: PPPC/DMAP procurement records list an Invitation to Early Market Engagement for Expansion of the National Data Centre under ref MW-PPPC-494042-GO-RFB, published 12 Feb 2026. Search result text identifies the existing facility as a Tier 3 data centre in Lilongwe. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: OCL Enterprise Data Center, Kanengo, Lilongwe
notes: OCL says it built a world-class enterprise data centre in Kanengo, Lilongwe and invited customers to enterprise colocation services from 1 Dec 2023, with redundant power, cooling and network connectivity. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: MTL Data Centre, Lilongwe
notes: MTL advertises data centre hosting services, and Datacenters.com lists the MTL Data Centre in Lilongwe as colocation infrastructure. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Converged Technology Networks Micro Data Centre, Lilongwe
notes: ITWeb Africa reported CTN announced plans to build Malawi's first AI-focused Micro Data Centre using GPUs under a GPU-as-a-Service model. CTN public company profile locates its headquarters in Lilongwe; exact facility site and MW capacity were not disclosed.

name: Mzuzu University research data centre concept
notes: Academic/project materials discuss a proposed data centre that could be located in Mzuzu University's new library, with the library construction expected 2021-2023. Treated as weak/concept evidence because no later official completion or commercial operation source was found. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: National Data Centre, Blantyre
notes: DCD reported the Government of Malawi launched a Huawei-built National Data Centre in Blantyre on 28 Jul 2022 to host government-wide systems. Machine Learning Malawi describes it as a Tier 3 facility implemented by Huawei with ESCOM under the national fibre backbone initiative. No MW capacity disclosed.

name: Reserve Bank of Malawi Corporate Data Centre, Blantyre Branch
notes: Reserve Bank of Malawi tender notice sought an eligible firm to design and construct a modern Corporate Data Centre at the Blantyre branch, with tender aggregators showing publication in late Sep 2025 and late-2025 closing dates. No MW capacity disclosed.
